provider: Washington State Department of Revenue, Research and Fiscal Analysis
dataset_name: Local Taxing District Levy Detail (statewide, all taxing districts)

cadence.pattern: annual tables publish October-November of the tax-due year; due-2026 tables expected late 2026

human_inspection_urls.label: DOR local taxing district levy detail (landing page, 2002-2025)

coverage_jurisdictions_note: The levy detail covers every taxing district in all 39 counties. Claimed jurisdictions are those with reviewed validation checks; county-level claims are promoted by adding a named levy-total check for the county and an entry here.

machine_access.url_discovery: Never guess /sites/default/files/{YYYY-MM}/ directories: they reflect upload month and move on silent re-uploads. Re-scrape the landing pages to resolve current URLs.

retrieval_context.row_filter: column A matches ^\d{9}$ (one row per LEVY)
retrieval_context.column_mapping: positional (prior-year header text embeds shifting literal years); gated by a header-shape check on the stable leading columns
retrieval_context.tdcode_scheme: bytes 1-2 county (alphabetical, 17=King), 3-4 district type (04=local school), 5-7 district id, 8-9 levy type (1=school enrichment)

version_boundary.publication_cadence: annual, October-November of the tax-due year; 2026 tables expected late 2026

safe_answer_patterns: Which taxing districts levy property tax in a county, with certified amounts and rates, for tax years due 2024 and 2025.
Year-over-year levy change at DISTRICT level (aggregate district_key = TDCODE bytes 1-7; surface base-levy, lid-lift, and bond lines separately).
School district enrichment (EP&O), capital projects, and bond levies per district with rates and amounts.
County and statewide levy totals and assessed-value context.
Levy-lid context: statutory maximum rates and the 101% limit columns per levy.
not_supported_by_this_source: An individual address's or parcel's tax bill or levy stack (needs county tax-code-area data; King County publishes that only as PDF rate books).
Ballot-measure linkage: no measure numbers, election dates, or approval percentages.
Property tax collections or delinquencies (these are certified levies due, not collections).
Assessed-value appeals, exemptions, or senior-relief detail.
Future-year levies before DOR publishes them.

coverage_claims.time_coverage: Tax years due 2024 and 2025 checked in; DOR series reaches back to 2002 for future extension.
caveats: One row per LEVY: a district's base levy, lid lifts, and bonds are separate lines; district-level statements must aggregate the district key and name the lines.
Certified levy amounts due, not collections and not budgets.
Rates are dollars per $1,000 of assessed value; district-level only - household math needs the parcel's assessed value and must be labeled illustrative.
51 new and 68 dropped levy codes between 2024 and 2025: handle births and deaths explicitly in trends.

comparability_notes: Certified levies due are not comparable to budget authority or actual collections without explicit framing.
Levy rates are only comparable between districts with the same assessed-value base year.
Statewide and county totals reconcile exactly with DOR Tables 8/12/14 (verified 2026-07-13).

coverage_claims.unsupported_reason: Unsupported by this source: certified property-tax levies are revenue-side amounts due, not operating budget authority.
Unsupported by this source: levies due are certified amounts, not budgeted or forecast revenue; treat revenue-budget claims separately.
Unsupported by this source: no staffing data.
Unsupported by this source: no spending, payments, or transactions.

caveats: Certified property-tax levies due per taxing district, as published by DOR - not bills, not collections, not budgets.

One row per levy; lid lifts and bonds are separate lines from the base levy (verified example: Seattle city's base rate fell 2024->2025 while its lid-lift line rose after the November 2024 transportation levy).
Cross-file reconciliation verified 2026-07-13: statewide, King County, and school-enrichment totals match DOR Tables 8/12/14 to the dollar.
DOR silently re-uploads corrected files months later; snapshots are pinned by sha256 and refreshes must re-scrape the landing page.
